narrative.overview:
A Quarto book set out like a field guide. Chapters are thumb-indexed sections, with tabs on the right edge of the sidebar. Each chapter opens with an oversized numeral, and each figure and table is a numbered plate under a rule. Flat, quiet and text-first: navy-slate ink on cool paper, one blue accent, hairline rules. Light by default; a sidebar toggle switches to dark mode, which uses a neutral near-black ground with grey text and keeps navy for the accent.

Brand commitment (PRODUCT.md, 2026-11-25): the palette and type follow Rational AI's public site (rationalai.co). That means Source Serif 4, IBM Plex Sans and Mono, navy-slate ink on cool paper, and their blue as the only accent. Their logo, their name as a brand, their contour motif and their page layout are not used. The frame stays Qual2Cast's. There is no Columbia branding.

People write every sentence. The theme styles what authors wrote and adds no words. Drafting placeholders are plain (a grey dashed outline around the authors' own text) because they are temporary. Rejected looks: the stock Quarto/Bootstrap book (grey sidebar text, blue links, cosmo headings), marketing gloss, dashboard panels and KPI tiles.
keyCharacteristics: Thumb-index tabs on the sidebar's edge; the current chapter's tab is wide and in the accent.
An oversized serif chapter numeral in the accent, set beside the title.
Figures and tables as plates: a 1px ink rule over the caption, with a 3rem accent stub at its left end.
Tabular lining figures wherever numbers are compared.
Prose held to a 38rem measure; plates take the full body width.
No shadows; structure comes from hairlines and the sidebar's tone.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue marks position and numbering only: where you are (current tab, active TOC entry, hover, focus) and what to point at (chapter and section numerals, plate stubs, link underlines). Nothing else is blue.

rules.name: The Plain Drafts Rule
rules.body: An unwritten slot (the "To write" box) gets a 1px dashed Strong Hairline outline and nothing else: no fill, colour, chip or mark. CAPTION TODO and ALT TODO read as the authors' plain placeholder text.

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: Every colour is a `$q2c-*` token with a value in both theme files. Tints are `color-mix()` of the accent with paper or transparent, never new literals. The one literal is the dark-mode white figure plate.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Numbers that get compared use tabular lining figures: tables, chapter and section numerals, sidebar numbers, plate numbers and the fact lists in "To write" boxes. Body text uses lining figures.

rules.name: The Serif Names Rule
rules.body: Source Serif 4 carries names and numerals: the site name, headings, chapter numerals and prev/next chapter numbers. IBM Plex Sans carries reading, labels and navigation, and is narrowed only in tables (85%) and in draft fact lists (92%).

rules.name: The Rules Not Shadows Rule
rules.body: Structure comes from lines and the sidebar's tone. Nothing floats.

dos: Do take every colour from a `$q2c-*` token and give it a dark value in `theme-dark.scss`.
Do keep the accent on position and numbering only (The One Accent Rule).
Do set compared numbers in tabular lining figures.
Do hold prose to the 38rem measure and let figures and tables take the full body width.
Do add styling hooks as spans and classes only, the way `_plates.html` does.
Do keep text at 4.5:1 or better on paper and on the sidebar, in both modes (lowest today: light Slate Grey on the sidebar, 4.93:1; dark accent on the ground and sidebar, 5.41:1).
Do keep figures on white plates in dark mode.
donts: Don't add words from the theme: no CSS-generated text, labels or headings. Placeholders stay the authors' own text. Empty `content: ""` for drawn rules and tabs is fine.
Don't use Rational AI's logo, name, contour motif or page layout.
Don't use dashed lines for anything but unwritten slots.
Don't stripe tables or fill cells; use rules, plus the 7% accent row hover.
Don't build dashboard panels or KPI tiles.
Don't put uppercase labels above headings as kickers. Small uppercase is for metadata, column heads, navigation group names.
Don't lighten the light-mode accent toward Rational AI's blue-500; it falls under 4.5:1 for small text.
